profile.headline: Software Engineer | SDET | Playwright | Python | Automation Frameworks | CI/CD | Azure DevOps
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer specializing in automation framework engineering, modernizing test platforms, and improving developer productivity through scalable automation. 

Over the past several years, I’ve led initiatives to: 
- Lead the migration from Java/Groovy to Python
- Design a scalable Python automation framework using Behave BDD, the Page Object Model, and reusable framework components
- Lead the migration from Selenium to Playwright
- Help transition engineering workflows from GitHub/Jenkins to Azure DevOps Repos and Pipelines
- Improve automation execution performance by approximately 25% through framework optimization and parallel execution. 

I enjoy solving complex engineering problems by building reliable, maintainable systems that improve software quality and make developers more productive. 

Core Technologies:
• Python
• Playwright
• Pytest
• Selenium
• REST APIs
• Azure DevOps
• CI/CD
• Git
• React

I’m always interested in connecting with software engineers, automation engineers, and organizations building modern engineering platforms.

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
I design and build scalable automation solutions that improve software quality, modernize engineering workflows, and increase developer productivity for Gogo’s aviation connectivity platform.
• Led the technical evaluation and migration of the enterprise automation framework from Java/Groovy to Python, recommending Python based on maintainability, open-source support, and long-term sustainability.
• Architected a scalable Python automation framework using Behave BDD, Cucumber, Page Object Model, reusable framework components, and centralized configuration.
• Led the migration from Selenium to Playwright, improving automation reliability, maintainability, and execution performance.
• Helped migrate repositories from GitHub to Azure DevOps Repos and CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins to Azure DevOps Pipelines.
• Improved automation execution time by approximately 25% through synchronization optimization, parallel execution, and framework redesign.
• Developed reusable modules for browser management, API endpoint management, environment configuration, common utilities, and DynamoDB interactions, reducing duplicated code and simplifying maintenance.
• Implemented retry logic and environment-aware browser execution using headed Chrome locally and headless Chrome in Azure DevOps Pipelines.
• Develop automated UI, REST API, integration, and end-to-end tests using Playwright, Pytest, Behave BDD, and Python.
• Partner with software engineers, DevOps engineers, QA engineers, and product owners to define automation strategy, investigate defects, and continuously improve software quality.
positions.insights: Jenkins, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +8 skills

positions.title: Customer Support Team Lead
positions.description:
As Customer Support Team Lead, I led a technical support team while serving as the primary liaison between Customer Support, Engineering, QA, and Product teams. This role gave me the opportunity to work closely with software engineers, troubleshoot complex production issues, and contribute to improving software quality and release readiness.
• Led day-to-day operations of a high-performing technical support team supporting business aviation connectivity products.
• Partnered with Engineering and QA to troubleshoot production issues, validate software fixes, analyze application logs, and support software releases.
• Performed root cause analysis on complex customer issues, helping identify defects and improve product reliability.
• Collaborated on internal tooling, automation initiatives, and process improvements that reduced manual effort and improved team efficiency.
• Coordinated team training, mentoring, workload prioritization, and performance development while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture.
• Developed a passion for software engineering through close collaboration with development teams, ultimately transitioning into Test Automation Software Engineering.

positions.title: Customer Care Engineer
positions.description:
As a Customer Care Engineer, I partnered with customers and internal engineering teams to troubleshoot complex software issues, resolve technical problems, and improve the overall customer experience. This role strengthened my technical troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration skills while laying the foundation for my career in software engineering.
• Resolved complex software and application issues for enterprise customers through technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
• Collaborated with Engineering, QA, and Product teams to investigate defects, validate fixes, and improve product quality.
• Diagnosed issues using application logs, databases, and internal tools to identify software defects and recommend solutions.
• Built strong customer relationships by translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance.
• Contributed to process improvements that increased support efficiency and improved customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Apple Technician
positions.description:
As a Family Room Specialist at Apple, I provided hands-on technical support for Apple hardware and software while delivering an exceptional customer experience. This role strengthened my troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills and sparked my passion for technology.
• Diagnosed and resolved hardware and software issues across the Apple product ecosystem.
• Guided customers through technical troubleshooting, product education, and repair solutions.
• Built strong customer relationships by translating technical concepts into clear, easy-to-understand guidance.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience in a fast-paced retail environment.

projects.title: SwoleMates
projects.description: A health-focused app for users to be able to track workouts and nutritional data with a social media component to inspire friendly competition among the users. Visit the live web page here: https://true-swole-mates.herokuapp.com/

projects.title: BrightIdeas
projects.description: A simple and concise project management system where a user can create and manage their projects from start to finish. They can create a project including relevant information about their client, and within each project they can add items to the 'Project Asks' container, tasks to the 'Tasks' container, and also comments in the 'Activity Feed' container in order to keep track of all relevant activities. You cab view the live page at: https://gentle-wildwood-55104.herokuapp.com/
